summary: Iteration 30 — RETEST after main agent wired '+ Pick upgrade' into the actually-rendered GlobalTradeBuilder.jsx (was previously misplaced in dead-code TradeBuilder.tsx). All targeted retest items now PASS: (1) add-pick-upgrade-btn renders alongside + Player stat and + Team result inside the open Trade Builder; (2) pick-upgrades-empty is visible BEFORE any row is added with the correct copy 'Add a draft pick to this trade first…'; (3) clicking + Pick upgrade mounts pick-upgrade-row-0 with all 6 child selectors (pick, team, trigger, new-round, new-year, remove); (4) clicking pick-upgrade-remove-0 returns the editor to the empty state; (5) + Player stat editor (TradeConditionsEditor) still works alongside the new editor — adds a new condition row without affecting pick-upgrade rows; (6) backend pytest test_pick_upgrades.py — both championship-trigger and downgrade tests pass (2/2 PASSED, 1.5s); (7) /api/auth/login + /api/auth/me regressions both 200 OK. The previously SKIPPED upgrade test now PASSES because the test now resets pick.current_team_id during teardown, restoring R2 partner-pick seed state.

integration_issues.issue: Could not interactively verify the Upgrade/Downgrade badge swap (TEST 4) because adding a draft pick to the trade requires navigating to the partner team and using a pick-level trade icon, which is not surfaced as a clear data-testid on the current Team page (no pick-trade-btn-* nodes found in DOM). Static review of PickUpgradeEditor.tsx lines 138-186 confirms the badge logic is correct (newRound < currentRound → 'Upgrade'; > → 'Downgrade'), and backend pytest test_pick_downgrade_clause_supported passes end-to-end on the actual round-mutation logic. Suggest exposing a pick-trade-btn-{pickId} data-testid on partner roster pick rows to make this fully UI-testable.
